meta.title: Switch the QCS between vertical and horizontal view

steps.note: Open an existing event with vendor quotations, as required by the setup.
Open and verify that the Master QCS comparison grid with vendor bids is rendered.
Record that the initial QCS contains real vendor quotation columns.
Verify the control for switching to the horizontal layout is available.
Switch the QCS to the horizontal view.
Verify the layout toggle now indicates the vertical view can be selected.
Verify the same QCS still shows real vendor quotation columns after the first switch.
Switch the QCS back to the vertical view.
Verify the layout toggle has returned to the horizontal-switch state.
Verify vendor quotation columns remain present after the second switch.
